description: Machine-readable identity for shared-solver modules, CLIs, and checks. Status fields prevent mistaking exploration/experimental code for correctness sources.

notes: correctnessSource=true means the module participates in the trusted semantic or DP correctness path.
experimental/exploration modules may generate candidates or diagnostics but must not be cited as proof that a route is impossible.
Test grade smoke may pass with found=false; only closure-grade tests assert found+strict replay.

pathRules.recommendedAction: keep as manifest/inventory tooling; regenerate and validate before changing module identity
archive to _archive/experiments/pre-canonical/; do not treat as canonical
keep as regression/check script; consult tests grade in solver-manifest
keep as CLI orchestration; no reusable logic growth
keep as debug tool; not a correctness search
exploration only; never treat miss as proof of no route
exploration/local search helper; not global correctness proof
keep as route debugger rendering helper
stable public API surface for agents; keep thin
